title: Research: audit PR #5496's multi-target CRT row join and its exact shared ROM-bank storage (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/crt-multitarget-row-audit/`, an independent audit of the multi-target loop in [PR #5496](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5496)'s current-row CRT join. PR #5496 connects current CRT offsets to a physical Beneš row query, but its completed joined fixtures have only one active target. This audit proves that its loop composes across several right targets: idle records are still consumed, successive active targets use their own offsets, padded coordinates are queried, one physical ROM bank is reused, and complete old tails and numerical outputs retire. No defect was found in this implication.

The result is conditional. The numerical Entry theorem (PR #5353's RowEntry over PR #5219/#5053) and the ROM producer theorem (PR #5092) are hypotheses of this audit, not re-proved here; the finite executions corroborate the implication and do not discharge those universal producer hypotheses.

The new exact storage lemma counts all 52 roles of the fixed-precision singleton-ROM bank. For nonempty active targets, guide width P and largest active width H,

```text
B(P,H) = 5 P 2^H (H^2+3H+1) + 2^H(4H-1) + 48P + 2H + 104.
```

Each role's extent is nondecreasing in target width at fixed P, so the rolewise historical maximum is attained at H. The proof also counts the three disjoint coordinate/countdown/output backings. At P=11, the h=3→h=2 fixture retains 9,086 bank cells; billing only the last target would count 3,084 and omit 6,002. This is a rejecting control for an invalid shortcut, not a counterexample to #5496's conservative invoice. The inherited arena count and general historical-maximum principle are credited, not claimed as new.

Result kind: scoped conditional proof audit, exact footprint lemma, and finite independent corroboration. No implementation, recursive invoice, paid profile, selected result or κ changes. Retain the full numerical Entry/retirement, each complete ROM production, all-layer disposal and adapter work. Complete physical level/key composition and all-size transfer remain open.

## Task and overlap

The chooser's adversarial-audit draw used seed `44f05f574fc586d49962b167a149c6d8`, suggestion 2. [TASK.json](research/crt-multitarget-row-audit/TASK.json) retains the full original card, selection, bounded method, stop rule, acceptance gate and remaining obligations. The card asks for one quantified CRT implication at its actual caller; #5496 supplies that concrete successor interface. The expansion decision is to stop after this audit.

Head `53a034436f17ef5b8fdf7a02f5066528cdfe5446` on base main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Canonical main was checked again at 2026-10-25 05:50:02 UTC and 06:08:00 UTC and was unchanged, as was the #5496 head. `certificates/selected-result.json` on this base selects #5413 (κ = 0.003027288235, promoted 23 October); the priority page's 23 October note still names #4610. This audit neither replays nor changes either record.

The claim is in [Discussion #4709, comment 19173680](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19173680), following [#5496's record](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4709#discussioncomment-19173182). Nearest overlap: [#5496](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5496) constructs the join; this independently audits its multi-target boundary and exact storage. JoyboyBrian's [#5505](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5505) treats changing-precision numerical-bank histories, while this treats the fixed-P ROM bank. JoyboyBrian's [#5486](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5486) lowers a different fixed repair program to binary control. Earlier BIT/control/parking audits by this account are different objects.

Offline overlap queries covered the task, #5496/current-row-query, multi-axis/two-active-target work, ROM bank, producer footprint and 48P, together with main research/ledger inspection. The final snapshot covers 371 open PRs at 05:43:08.927390 UTC and 4,779 Discussion records at 05:44:30.637331 UTC, with complete pagination and all 7,404 local note records. Arbitrary remote code diffs and unpublished work remain outside that coverage; it is not a novelty guarantee.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3, standard library only; serial execution. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-multitarget-row-audit --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-multitarget-row-audit
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/crt-multitarget-row-audit --check-source-history
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/crt-multitarget-row-audit --ref HEAD --output crt-multitarget-row-audit.tar
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check crt-multitarget-row-audit.tar
```

All passed. The registered replay executes normal and optimized Python serially, each with a 300-second limit. Each finishes:

```text
PASS_CRT_MULTITARGET_ROW_AUDIT cases=9 producer_calls=13 controls=12 no_new_kappa=true
```

The nine cases execute 13 complete ROM calls at h≤3, covering distinct offsets, growing/shrinking banks, leading/trailing idle axes, padded current values, invalid left input, all-idle behavior and minimum-width nonroot entry. The independent oracle searches CRT congruences and exhausts network color constraints; it does not execute #5496's checker, the retained Caller oracle or the retained Beneš reference. Calibration covers 32 networks and all 236 addresses.

Twelve control groups cover seven execution faults, two algebraic discriminators, two storage omissions and JSON boolean/integer confusion. Every actual producer role extent, canonical table, bank identity, historical tail, borrowed input/head and all 63 numerical owned ports are checked. Adapter tape actions are measured separately against the inherited 4096F allowance; the complete instruction constant is not independently certified.

Committed bytes/source ancestry and the official 28-file export pass. An optimized direct replay from the extracted export without Git history passes and leaves all 29 extracted files (including the export receipt) unchanged. Separate corruption of a vendored source and a main scientific source is rejected before replay; both copies are restored. Registered normal+optimized replay took 125.77 seconds, peak 203,408 KiB; standalone optimized replay took 63.98 seconds, peak 22,544 KiB on the checking host.

Not run: h=4 joined pipeline, uninterrupted whole-level update, complete three-epoch key, binary numerical compiler, full E(p,ell), native/ordinary/outer or selected scientific replay, Lean. No independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is asserted.

## Open next questions

[README.md](research/crt-multitarget-row-audit/README.md#open-next-questions) and TASK.json identify two remaining physical boundaries. The smallest useful follow-up is a paid update of the actual encoded axis source from this returned stream, followed by the next row without host serialization. Start with the five-row h=3/h=2 example; a source update/ownership contract is the blocker. This continues #5496's existing open question.

Then bind the three changing-left-state epochs of an exceptional reverse key, starting from Hiroki KUMAZAKI's #4716 stale-offset discriminators and pricing source-coordinate conversions and restoration. A larger ROM sample alone would not resolve either obligation.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The uniform-transfer card's existing_checks still stops at #4100; linking its concrete caller successors and their distinct open obligations would reduce rediscovery. No guidance files are changed here.
